dimensions.assessment: Directly affects individuals whose Social Security numbers have been misused or whose cards have been lost in transit.
dimensions.evidence: any individual whose social security account number has been misused... or whose Social Security card has been lost in the course of transmission

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative assistance and casework tracking for affected individuals to help resolve identity theft issues.
dimensions.evidence: track the individual's case to completion and coordinate with other units to resolve issues as quickly as possible

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state federal spending or budgetary appropriations.
Amends title VII of the Social Security Act to mandate specific internal agency procedures and staffing provisions.
dimensions.evidence: The Commissioner of Social Security shall establish and implement procedures to ensure that any individual... has a single point of contact

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent procedural requirement for the Social Security Administration.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall take effect 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific cost or budget appropriations required for implementation
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Social Security Administration to provide a dedicated single point of contact and team for victims of identity theft whose numbers were misused or cards lost in transit, improving administrative case tracking.
